author: savemygame
quote: It's not even GTA. I can't play the game the way I want to. Jason HAS to be in a relationship with Lucia, and Lucia HAS to be in a relationship with Jason. I can't even play GTA because everything in this bs **** revolves around their relationship. I want to cheat on Jason as Lucia or cheat on Lucia as Jason. NOPE, I can't do that. Also, why is Jason just a straight-up simp? She literally tells him she birthed his child, then hid his child from him, then robbed a store, and got the child taken away by DCF, and this dudes only response is "I am so happy!" Who really wrote this **** game? They need to be fired immediately. It's like, okay, the story ****, so I'm just going to do GTA **** in my GRAND THEFT AUTO game, and NOPE, can't even do that. Another great franchise ruined. Might as well have called this Grand Theft SIMS! Because it feels and just plays like a first-person Sims game. How do you drop the ball this hard when you've taken 13 years? If it had bugs and the story ****, I would still be mad, but at least I can just play the open world and commit crimes and stuff. I was so hyped for this game, and the more I play, the more disappointed I am. All these quid pro quo reviewers giving this BS a 10 out of 10 is just so disgusting to see. It's a good-looking game, but it's not GTA. I paid $100 for GTA, not a relationship simulator. Hell, I would have been okay with paying $200 if the quality was there—just so disappointing, man. I'm so sad.
